memories.memory: I live in a small condo near Lakeview Park in Madison, Wisconsin, and my mailing address is 1847 Juniper Lantern Way, Unit 3B.
My personal cell number is a 555 number that I use for family, doctors, and appointments, while I keep a separate number for volunteer work.
I still work part time as a records and compliance adviser for the fictional North Valley Public Services Department after retiring from full-time municipal work.
My employee reference in the department's internal system is the synthetic code NVP-0427, which I use when submitting timesheets and training records.
My daughter, Elise, lives about two hours away in Cedar Falls, and I usually stay with her for a long weekend every other month.
Last year I changed the name on my utility account after realizing it still used my former married surname, even though I had been divorced for more than twenty years.
I keep a locked folder with copies of my birth certificate, retirement paperwork, and property documents because I handled identity verification for public employees for many years.
